decision.text: 题目候选按评测时需要的仿真能力分为需要SPICE器件求解与纯Verilog-A两类；建设优先纯Verilog-A；纯VA能力EVAS不支持的提issue推动EVAS改动，台架默认不改。

definitions.spice: 评测台架或交付物需要SPICE器件求解：晶体管、二极管等器件实例或模型（含PDK/sky130 include、model卡），作为电路元件的R/L/C，独立或受控电流源，simulator lang=spice器件网表，含器件的subckt，或交付物本身是器件网表。
definitions.pure-va: 评测只含Verilog-A模块（候选及固定的支持或DUT模块）和独立电压源。真值可以来自已存的晶体管仿真数据，此时stored_device_truth=true。
definitions.blocks_all_candidates: 缺口状态为rejected或rejected-resource，且位于台架或台架实例化的固定支持模块；起始模型、参考解与未实例化的公开材料中的写法不算。

basis.bench-scanned: bench files of the candidate itself were scanned
basis.proxy-bench: bench of the released task with the same v4 family ID was scanned
basis.excerpt-only: no in-repo bench; inventory excerpt, title and label only

gap_status.rejected: EVAS source or docs reject the construct before simulation
gap_status.rejected-resource: a documented EVAS resource budget is exceeded
gap_status.conditional: documented rejection that applies only when the source has a cross/held-timer/operator consumer; no direct consumer was found (indirect uses are not traced)
gap_status.conditional-consumer-found: documented consumer boundary with a direct consumer found in the VA
gap_status.named-by-label: construct named only by a title or source label (excerpt-only items)
gap_status.possible: LRM item that depends on the include structure
gap_status.doc-conflict: README says rejected, source at the same commit accepts
gap_status.needs-evas-confirmation: documented boundary whose application to this form EVAS should confirm

roles.fixed_support: fixed VA module used by the bench
roles.fixed_support_copy: copy of a fixed module for the candidate
roles.starter: candidate starting file (modules also in the reference solution)
roles.public_material: non-candidate VA published with the task but not instantiated by any scanned netlist
roles.calibration_variant: checker calibration variant (scanned, excluded from gaps)

method.scope: Static reading only. EVAS gaps list only constructs that EVAS docs or source at the commit reject, place out of scope or limit by a resource budget. No EVAS, Spectre or VA run. An item without a listed gap is not shown to run on EVAS.
